summary.overrun_rule: Upper bands are judged one-sided with an exact binomial check: a band is said to understate overruns when seeing that many matters above it, or more, would happen less than 1 time in 20 if the band were right. With about a dozen matter types and two bands each, expect the odd flag by chance.
summary.method: Walk-forward. Each matter is modeled only from same-type matters that closed before it opened, using time dated before it opened. Abnormally closed matters are neither tested nor used as comps. Amounts are at today's standard rates on both sides.
